subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@finpay.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@finpay.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps.

Recap
- Primary objective: customer-facing summarization API for FinPay support flows.
- Target SLO: p95 latency < 150–200ms for single-turn requests (average payload ~ 250 tokens), with occasional spikes.
- Sustained throughput: baseline ~ 25–40 requests/sec, peak bursts up to ~80 requests/sec.
- Data: no on-prem data residency required today; standard SOC2 controls required.

Qualification
- If you need p95 < 200ms consistently under sustained >30 rps, Dedicated capacity is usually the safer path (reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput).
- Hosted API can handle bursty workloads and is fastest to go live; good for early testing or <30 rps sustained with relaxed p95 targets.

Proposed next steps
1) We'll run a short perf validation using a sample payload set you shared (send any additional edge cases).
2) I'll attach our quick latency run (prelim) and a proposal for a 4-week PoC on Dedicated capacity if you want predictable p95/throughput.
3) Pricing/contract: I'll follow up with a scope addendum for PoC and the Dedicated sizing recommendation.

I'm looping in Dylan for sizing and PoC logistics. Let us know if the p95/throughput numbers above match FinPay's expectations.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@finpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up

Thanks, Neha — helpful recap.

Clarifying details from our side:
- Target p95 of 150ms is aspirational; acceptable up to 200ms if it's consistent.
- Typical payloads are 200–400 tokens; worst-case up to 1200 tokens for long threads (rare).
- Sustained traffic expected during U.S. business hours: ~35–45 rps. Night/weekends much lower.
- Procurement timeline: aim to decide by end of June; PoC would need to start mid-June.

Question: with Hosted API, can you guarantee p95 < 200ms for sustained 40 rps without rate-limiting or significant per-token cost increases? If not, please call out trade-offs.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product
FinPay
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@finpay.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up

Great context — thanks Elena.

Quick answers and recommended path:
- Hosted API: can meet ~200ms p95 for moderate sustained loads, but latency and cost become less stable as sustained rps approaches 40+ without reserved capacity. We typically recommend Hosted for early tests and bursty traffic; not ideal if you need consistent sub-200ms p95 at sustained 40 rps.
- Dedicated: provides predictable performance (reserved GPU pools) and simpler cost forecasting for sustained traffic. For your payload distribution, we'd size a Dedicated pool to handle 45 rps p95 <200ms with room for headroom (proposal attached).

Attached: finpay_latency_report.pdf — preliminary benchmark using a similar model and payload set.
Related: https://redwood.drive/finpay/poc-specs (PoC plan and monitoring dashboard links).

Dylan — can you confirm sizing recommendation and suggested PoC timeline? If we agree, I'll prepare a short PoC SOW and pricing addendum.

Thanks,
Neha

--
Attachment: finpay_latency_report.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up

Quick sizing note:
- Based on FinPay's token distribution and target p95 <200ms at 45 rps, recommended starting point is a 2-GPU Dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) with autoscaling headroom.
- Expected results from our lab runs: p50 ~ 40–60ms, p95 ~ 140–180ms at 45 rps on the sized pool; sustained throughput up to 60 rps with autoscale.

Proposed PoC (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: finalize SOW & sign PoC addendum (standard PoC MSA).
2) Week 1: provision Dedicated PoC environment, integrate FinPay test keys, and set up dashboards.
3) Week 2: run synthetic + replay tests (you provide sample traffic) and tune batching/kv cache.
4) Week 3: run production-like traffic window and handoff recommendations.

I'll prepare the sizing appendix and PoC timeline once Neha approves.

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@finpay.com>

Thanks all — this is very helpful and aligns with our expectations.

FinPay would like to proceed with the 4-week Dedicated PoC. Next asks:
- Please send PoC SOW and pricing addendum.
- Requested start window: week of June 14.
- Please include monitoring access and success criteria (p95 <200ms for agreed test windows).

Elena
